column2: A small sailboat rocks sharply between a deep trough and a steep rising wave, its passengers gripping the rail.
A roomy bedroom contains a bed, armchair and desk with generous clear floor space between every piece.
Waves break rhythmically against a rocky shore, with curling foam and small sound vibration marks beside the impact.
A cow opens its mouth to moo beside a field gate, stretching its neck toward the waiting farmer.
A defeated team trudges away from a game, with collapsed shoulders while the opposing team celebrates an overwhelming victory.
A pig roots into soft ground with its snout, pushing a small mound of earth aside beneath its nose.
A pirate boards a merchant vessel from a small boat, carrying a sack and wearing practical historical seafaring clothes.
A thoughtful adult considers a difficult chess position, chin on hand while the opponent waits beside the board.
Runny honey flows easily from a tilted spoon, forming a thin continuous stream onto a piece of bread.
A hungry traveler becomes satisfied after a full meal, resting comfortably beside an empty bowl and unused extra bread.
A child looks thoroughly tired of a favorite sweet, turning away from a large remaining bowl with a grimace.
A sanitation worker clears litter from a roadside gutter, using a long grabber and a partly filled refuse sack.
A school textbook lies open to an illustrated geometry lesson, with a pencil and exercise book beside it.
A sports scorer records a basketball shot from a courtside desk, watching the hoop beside an open scoring sheet.
Two people scour a room for a missing key, lifting cushions and looking beneath a small cabinet.
An open scrapbook contains pasted photographs, dried leaves and ticket shapes, with scissors and glue nearby.
A hurried hand scribbles rough uneven strokes across a page, holding the pen loosely above scattered blank sheets.
A child secretly taking a biscuit pauses guiltily, looking back toward a trusting parent with a troubled expression.
Two clothed children scuffle on a lawn, gripping each other's sleeves while an adult approaches to separate them.
A sculptor carves a bird from a wooden block, holding a small chisel above fresh curled shavings.
A mouse scurries rapidly across a kitchen floor toward its hole, with quick short steps and a trailing tail.
A seabird glides above breaking coastal waves, wings spread broadly over the ocean with a rocky nesting ledge nearby.
A cook sears a steak in a hot skillet, revealing a deeply browned surface while turning it with tongs.
A large fishing hook is shown close up, with its small backward-facing barb clearly projecting beside the pointed tip.
A writer secludes themselves in a quiet garden hut, closing the door while a busy gathering remains far outside.
A secretary arranges appointments, correspondence and a telephone at a tidy desk just outside a manager's office.
Two children balance on opposite ends of a playground seesaw, its central pivot and raised end clearly visible.
A seedy coat hangs from a crooked peg, with frayed cuffs, missing buttons and a worn shiny collar.
An angry adult seethes silently at a queue-jumper, clenching their jaw and fists without speaking or striking.
A beginner practices a difficult guitar chord carefully, using a mirror to correct their own hand position.
An artist paints their self-portrait while studying a mirror, with the painted face clearly matching their own.
A family waves goodbye from a station platform as their relative leans from the departing train's open doorway.
A chisel lies beside its detached wooden handle, exposing the narrow metal shank that fits inside the grip.
A shifty trader smiles while hiding a damaged part of a product behind their back during a sale.
A thin wooden shim fills the gap beneath a short table leg, making all four legs rest securely.
A Shinto shrine entrance features a torii gate and a sacred rope with folded paper streamers around a nearby tree.
Shipbuilders assemble the curved ribs of a wooden hull on supports, with planks and clamps arranged beside it.
A shoelace threads through the eyelets of a sneaker, with its two ends tied into a simple bow.
A shoplifter slips a small boxed item into a coat pocket while the shopkeeper faces away at the counter.
A showy parade hat towers above its wearer, with bright feathers drawing every nearby spectator's attention.
A shrew stands beside fallen leaves, showing its pointed snout, tiny eyes and compact furry body with a long tail.
A mischievous owner urges a barking dog toward a trespasser, pointing forward while the dog strains against its lead.
An unpleasant rotten-food smell sickens a cook, who turns away pale-faced and covers their mouth beside the bin.
An open newspaper has a narrow shaded sidebar beside a larger main article, using pictures and unreadable line blocks.
A football field's sideline is clearly painted along the edge, separating a waiting substitute from the active players.
A mound of warm reddish-brown sienna earth pigment sits beside its open ceramic jar and a broad painter's brush.
A skyrocket firework rises from a safe empty field, leaving a bright narrow trail and a starburst high above.
Hands slacken a taut rope by feeding extra length through a cleat, creating a clear loose curve.
An inexpensive costume necklace has peeling metallic paint and loose plastic gems, lying beside its broken clasp.
A snake slithers smoothly across a flat stone, with its body forming connected shallow curves along the ground.
A worker slovenly tosses tools into an open drawer, leaving handles protruding and tangled cords hanging out.
A hostile critic publicly denounces an artist's work, pointing angrily at the painting while the artist looks hurt.
A loose artist's smock hangs on a peg, showing its roomy sleeves, protective front and several colorful paint marks.
Thick smoke makes an adult struggle for breath near an open window, with a rescuer reaching to help them out.
A smuggler conceals small contraband packages beneath a false suitcase lining, glancing nervously toward a distant customs desk.
Scissors snip a small leaf shape from green paper, with the cutout separating cleanly from the surrounding sheet.
An adult snoozes in an armchair, head tipped sideways above an open book resting loosely on their lap.
A pair of traditional snowshoes has broad oval wooden frames and woven webbing, strapped over sturdy winter boots.
A rude host snubs a guest by turning away mid-greeting, leaving the guest's offered hand hanging unanswered.
A small songbird sings from a branch, beak open and throat lifted above its neat cup-shaped nest.
Two negotiators each yield part of a disputed rope boundary, moving the dividing peg toward a shared middle position.
A women's student club meets around a dormitory lounge table, planning a shared event with craft supplies and photographs.
Three islands appear on a compass-oriented map, with the lowest southern island emphasized beneath the other two.
A long round wooden spar lies beside a sailing boat, with tapered ends and rigging rope attached around it.
A huge quantity of incoming parcels spills from a delivery cart, overflowing a small reception counter and nearby shelves.
A detached spearhead rests beside a wooden shaft, showing a pointed metal blade and hollow mounting socket.
A payment tray contains stacks of gold and silver coins, with paper banknotes set distinctly aside.
A speculator studies fluctuating commodity charts while buying a warehouseful of grain sacks, hoping to sell at a higher price.
An enthusiastic spender buys several unnecessary items, handing over coins while carrying many crowded shopping bags.
An adult vomits discreetly into an open bucket, bending forward while a companion holds back their hair.
A single coiled wire forms a clean rising spiral, with each turn evenly spaced around the central axis.
A sprightly older adult dances a lively step, lifting one foot while their delighted partner claps nearby.
A rotating garden sprinkler sends several arcs of water across a lawn, connected to a hose at its base.
A sprinter accelerates from starting blocks, body leaning forward and arms driving powerfully along a short track lane.
An adult rejects a dishonest offer, pushing a sealed bribe envelope back across the desk with a firm hand.
An agitated speaker splutters while arguing, with a few small saliva droplets escaping toward a recoiling listener.
A neglected room shows squalor through stained bedding, broken furnishings and accumulated refuse around a leaking bucket.
A squatter settles bedding inside an abandoned building through a broken window, with no lease or owner's permission depicted.
A tiny mouse squeaks from inside a teacup, its mouth open and whiskers raised toward a nearby cat.
A squeamish adult turns pale at a small scraped knee, looking away while another person calmly applies a bandage.
Water stagnates in a blocked drainage ditch, with algae, trapped leaves and a motionless surface behind the obstruction.
A celebrated film star steps from a limousine toward applauding fans, with photographers gathered behind a short barrier.
A ceramic beer stein stands on a wooden table, showing a sturdy side handle and a hinged pewter lid.
Sealed instruments undergo sterilization inside an open autoclave, with a gloved technician loading a metal instrument tray.
A stockbroker handles a client's share purchase at a desk, comparing market charts while speaking into a headset.
A shareholder holds a share certificate while attending a company's owner meeting, with the company's factory pictured behind the chairperson.
A goalkeeper stops a rolling ball with both hands, kneeling squarely between the ball and the open goal.
A compact hilltop stronghold has thick defensive walls, a guarded gate and towers enclosing the inner buildings.
A courteous host pulls out a chair for a guest, smiling calmly while gesturing toward the neatly set table.
A public official grants funds to a community garden, handing a coin-filled envelope to volunteers beside their new greenhouse.
Several jointed sugar-cane stalks grow upright, with long blade-like leaves and one cut stalk exposing a pale fibrous center.
A sulking child sits facing a wall, arms folded tightly and lower lip protruding beside a rejected toy.
A sundial has a triangular gnomon casting a narrow shadow across engraved radial hour grooves on a round stone plate.
A shallow tray holds miscellaneous small items: spare buttons, string, a thimble, corks and a tiny folded cloth.
An adult eats soup a little at a time, lifting a small spoonful while the full bowl remains nearby.
A supersonic jet outruns a cone of compressed air, shown as one clear cone trailing behind its sharp nose.
A surfer balances on a short board across a curling wave, knees bent and arms extended above the water.
A pair of suspenders stretches over a torso mannequin, clipped to the trouser waistband at front and back.
A swaggerer strides down a street with chest thrust out, elbows wide and chin raised above passing pedestrians.
A hand swats a fly on a tabletop with a flat flyswatter, caught just before contact without gore.
A Swedish traveler holds a passport bearing Sweden's yellow cross on blue, beside a matching small national flag.
A hand adds a spoonful of sweetener from a small unbranded jar into a steaming cup of tea.
A conductor leads a large orchestra through a symphony, with strings, woodwinds, brass and percussion all present.
An analyst synthesizes several colleagues' diagrams into one coherent plan, assembling their picture cards on a shared board.
A wooden table's broad smooth top is shown from slightly above, with its four edges and supporting legs visible.
A folded tortilla taco holds grilled meat, lettuce and tomato, with the open upper edge clearly showing the filling.
A tactful friend quietly helps conceal a guest's spilled drink, offering a napkin without drawing the group's attention.
A talker addresses two attentive friends, gesturing naturally while the others turn their faces toward the speaker.
A meddling visitor reaches into a technician's carefully arranged controls, while the technician urgently tries to stop the interference.
A child dangles a toy just beyond a puppy's reach, lifting it whenever the eager puppy jumps.
A work boot has sticky black tar coating its sole, leaving a dark tacky strand as it lifts from pavement.
A tawdry brooch combines oversized plastic gems and peeling gold paint, pinned to a badly frayed velvet ribbon.
A technologist tests a small robotic arm, adjusting its sensors beside a circuit board and precision tools.
An employee works from a home desk through a video meeting, with remote colleagues shown in simple picture windows.
A television camera films a chef preparing food, while a nearby television displays the same live cooking scene.
A noisy family quarrels around a dining table, waving arms and interrupting each other while plates rattle.
A person cautiously tests lukewarm bathwater with a wrist, relaxed rather than recoiling, beside the partly filled tub.
A meeting chairperson ends a prolonged session, closing the folder and gesturing for participants to leave their seats.
A reddish terracotta flowerpot has a matte unglazed surface, with one broken shard showing the same earthy color inside.
A small terracotta roof tile rests beside a clay figurine, both unglazed reddish-brown with a rough fired texture.
A threatening masked adult terrorizes shop occupants by looming in the doorway, while they retreat behind the counter; no weapons.
A scientist develops a theory from several observations, arranging specimen sketches into a consistent linked diagram above the workbench.
A thrifty adult repairs an old coat instead of buying a new one, saving spare coins in a jar.
An artist makes a casual brush gesture across a sketchpad, barely looking down while continuing a conversation.
A single anatomical heart is shown clearly, with its muscular chambers, attached major vessels and gentle contraction marks.
A timid child hesitates behind a parent's leg before greeting friendly classmates, peeking out with hunched shoulders.
One substantial bound volume sits alone on a reading stand, with its covers open and thick page block visible.
A smiling baby opens a toothless mouth, showing smooth pink gums without any erupted teeth.
A garden soil cutaway shows a dark crumbly topsoil layer above paler subsoil, with roots concentrated near the surface.
A torrential mountain stream surges between boulders, with white water rushing steeply down a narrow channel.
An authoritarian ruler controls a whole civic gathering from a raised platform, with guards watching uniformly directed citizens below.
A person carrying too many boxes totters sideways, lifting one foot awkwardly while the leaning stack threatens their balance.
A touchy guest reacts sharply to a harmless dropped spoon, shoulders tense while everyone else remains relaxed.
A caregiver calms a distressed child by sitting quietly beside them and gently rocking their favorite toy.
A train crosses the interior of one large continent, linking opposite coasts through mountains and plains on a single map.
A historical trapper carefully positions an empty cage trap near an animal trail, with no trapped or injured animal.
A clinician treats a small skin wound with clean dressings, while the patient watches calmly beside the supplies.
A hand places three identical bricks where one matching brick is used as the reference, showing a threefold quantity.
A globe shows the equator and two distinct parallel tropic circles, with the northern and southern tropics emphasized equally.
An elephant's head is shown in profile, emphasizing one long curved ivory tusk projecting beside the trunk.
Several small birds twitter together in a leafy hedge, tiny beaks open and bodies angled toward their neighbors.
A major industrial tycoon surveys several factories from an office, with managers presenting portfolios around the large desk.
A Tyrannosaurus stands in profile, with a massive toothed skull, powerful hind legs, long balancing tail and two-fingered forelimbs.
A child ties their own shoelaces unaided, while the nearby adult keeps both hands away and watches patiently.
A dominant chess player faces several challengers, with captured opposing pieces beside each board and none beside theirs.
An undefeated boxer stands upright with a collection of victory medals, while challengers wait beyond the ring ropes.
A sturdy cup remains intact beneath a falling wooden mallet, with the cup's strong rounded wall clearly visible.
An explorer discovers an island absent from their open sea chart, comparing its visible coastline with the blank map area.
An uncooperative teammate folds their arms and refuses to lift a shared table, leaving three companions straining under its weight.
A young child stands among adult relatives at a family gathering, their small stature and childlike clothing clearly evident.
An undersea diver swims among submerged rocks and kelp, with sunlight filtering down from the distant surface above.
An insurer accepts a signed policy for a cargo ship, placing it in a protective folder beside a ship model.
An official keeps a sealed confidential folder closed before curious reporters, holding it firmly against their chest.
An undiscovered cave lies behind dense vines, shown in cutaway while hikers pass without noticing its concealed entrance.
A stack of sealed applications waits untouched in an examiner's incoming tray, while the examined pile lies separately open.
An unimpressed spectator watches a flashy juggling act with folded arms and a flat expression while others applaud.
A traveler holding an incomplete map looks confused at a fork, while a guide possesses the missing map section.
A driver has car keys but an empty license-card sleeve, while an official refuses access to the vehicle.
A neglected teddy bear sits forgotten beneath a bed while its owner lovingly embraces several newer toys above.
An unread book still has uncut page folds and an intact paper wrapper, lying apart from worn open volumes.
An amateur ignores measured plant results and consults a lucky charm instead, leaving the experimental records unused nearby.
A screwdriver turns a screw out of a wooden hinge, with the threaded shaft emerging upward from its hole.
Several unsold loaves remain on a shop shelf as the baker closes the empty storefront for the evening.
An unspoiled forest lake has clear water, undisturbed vegetation and no buildings, litter or roads along its shore.
A broken umbrella is unusable, with bent ribs, torn fabric and a detached handle lying beside it.
A state's simplified map highlights its northern inland area, with a compass needle indicating the top and a southern city below.
Water surges upward from a newly opened spring, lifting a foamy mound above the surrounding shallow pool.
An urbane adult converses calmly in a stylish city cafe, wearing neat tailored clothes beside a refined table setting.
A dog urinates against a tree with one hind leg raised, shown discreetly from the side without anatomical detail.
A browser address bar contains a single simple website URL, with a pointer highlighting its location above a web page.
A usurper seizes a ruler's crown from its cushion, stepping toward the throne while the rightful ruler protests.
A tenant vacates an apartment, carrying the last box through the door and leaving the room completely empty.
A nurse vaccinates a seated adult's upper arm, holding a small syringe while a clean swab rests nearby.
A conquering army enters an opened fortress gate, while defenders lay down their shields without injury or blood.
A vegetarian meal contains beans, tofu, vegetables and rice, with a cook serving it from a plant-filled kitchen counter.
A faint footprint remains as a vestige in drying mud, with most of its outline already washed away.
An investigator carefully checks an applicant's documents and supporting records, comparing several folders under a desk lamp.
